Question: Gaming subtype / product
Why it matters: Avoid confusing dual-currency promotions and ordinary sweepstakes

Question: Customer-facing states
What to collect: Where are actual users located at wager and payout?
Why it matters: State rights are not inferred from incorporation

Question: Merchant legal entity
What to collect: Entity names and where licensed or registered

Question: Role in funds flow
What to collect: Deposit, wager, redeem, payout, settlement, wallet, third party?
Why it matters: Payment activity may create separate legal exposure

Question: Payout / prize redemption
Why it matters: Not every social or sweepstakes mechanic is wagering

Question: Wager acceptance
What to collect: Who receives stakes and who contracts with player?

Question: Game source / counterparty
What to collect: Licensed sportsbook, track, tribal entity, DCM?
Why it matters: Some models require linked licensed counterparties

Question: Applicable licenses
What to collect: License ID, regulator, approved markets, status
Why it matters: Never infer permission from company marketing

Question: Location controls
Why it matters: Need state and sometimes tribal/venue-level logic

Question: Age rules
What to collect: Age per game, state, jurisdiction and identity checks

Question: KYC / AML controls
Why it matters: Do not assume operator AML standard binds processor identically

Question: Vendor/processor registration
What to collect: Does state regulate suppliers, vendors or processors?
Why it matters: A legal game may still have vendor conditions

Question: Bank/sponsor/network permissions
Why it matters: Separate statutory legality from commercial acceptance policy

Question: Consumer safeguards
What to collect: Self-exclusion, responsible gaming, complaints and disclosures

Question: Legal opinion / counsel
Why it matters: Required for disputed, new or high-risk models

Question: Launch target date
What to collect: Launch date and whether approvals must predate it
Why it matters: Proposed rules, license starts and laws may shift
